summary: Hashes — CRC-32, MurmurHash3 x86-32, and XXH64 in pure Mojo.
description:
The three hashes Apache Iceberg and Parquet need: CRC-32 (deletion-vector
checksums, Parquet page CRCs, gzip), MurmurHash3 x86-32 seed 0 (Iceberg's
`bucket[N]` partition transform), and XXH64 seed 0 (Parquet split-block
bloom filters).

modules.summary: CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3 / zlib / gzip / PNG) — reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320, init/xorout 0xFFFFFFFF. Table-driven with a slice-by-8 fast path.
modules.description:
`crc32(data, seed=0)` reproduces `zlib.crc32(data)` in Python (and, by
extension, gzip/PNG CRCs). Passing a previous result as `seed` chains across
buffers exactly like zlib's `crc32(buf, crc)`:
`crc32(b, seed=crc32(a)) == crc32(a + b)`.

structs.name: Crc32
structs.summary: Incremental CRC-32. `seed` is the previous crc32 result (0 to start).

overloads.signature: def crc32(data: Span[UInt8], seed: UInt32 = UInt32(0)) -> UInt32

modules.summary: MurmurHash3_x86_32, plus the Iceberg Appendix-B pre-hash wrappers.
modules.description:
Iceberg's `bucket[N]` partition transform is `(hash(v) & Int32.MAX) % N`
where `hash` is MurmurHash3 x86-32 with seed 0 over a type-specific byte
serialization (spec: https://iceberg.apache.org/spec/#appendix-b-32-bit-hash-requirements).

overloads.signature: def murmur3_x86_32(data: Span[UInt8], seed: UInt32 = UInt32(0)) -> UInt32
def iceberg_hash_uuid(hi: UInt64, lo: UInt64) -> Int32
def iceberg_bucket(hash: UInt32, n: Int) -> Int

modules.description: Parquet split-block bloom filters hash column values with XXH64 seed 0.

structs.name: Xxh64
structs.summary: Incremental XXH64. `update` may be called any number of times before `finish`.

overloads.signature: def xxh64(data: Span[UInt8], seed: UInt64 = UInt64(0)) -> UInt64
